page.overview:
What is Akuma no Mi?

The Akuma no Mi is a Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a devil at will, allowing access to numerous demonic abilities. The user can bestow these abilities upon others in exchange gaining varying degrees of control over their minds and bodies. The fruit was eaten by Nerona Imu.

This ability's name is unique among Devil Fruits, as it is a single three-syllable word rather than a two-syllable pattern repeated once. The name is homophonous with the Japanese term for Devil Fruits in general; the only difference is that is spelled using katakana instead of kanji.

To distinguish this fruit's name from Devil Fruits in general, the VIZ translation has rendered it as "The Devil's Fruit". It is the only officially translated fruit name to utilize the possessive (the particle can be used to indicate possession).

Imu's devil transformation appears to resemble common depictions of . While his complete transformation is still silhouetted, it is extremely large, being roughly equivalent to the Five Elders' massive Mythical Zoan Beast Forms in size and occupying a considerable portion of the enormous platform beneath the Empty Throne. In the form displayed on Elbaph, Imu is several times larger than an average human, but is still much smaller than a giant. The transformation affords numerous demonic features and accessories, such as a pair of curly horns on the user's forehead and a long dark tail which bears at least three horned skulls on it. The tail appears to be tattered, or has an essence which is not entirely solid. The user also possesses a pair of large, feathered black wings that they can appear and disappear at will.
